description: Verify one connected Google account (the default, or the one named by `account`) using Gmail's minimal profile endpoint. Returns the account identity, its recorded tier, the scopes Google granted and any default scope the grant lacks (missing_default_scopes; null when the grant predates scope recording). This does not list Drive files or return third-party content.
embedding_description: Confirm that Google Workspace OAuth is currently usable through Gmail's minimal profile endpoint before relying on Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, or Slides operations. The bounded result identifies only the connected account and whether that harmless profile read succeeded; it neither lists Drive content nor returns third-party records.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Bounded verdict: account, account_identity, harmless_read_ok, account_tier, granted_scopes, missing_default_scopes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report only the connection verdict and account identity; do not infer access to a broader Workspace corpus.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Verify the connected Google Workspace account with a minimal profile read.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.not_connected means OAuth linking has not completed. gsuite.unknown_account means the `account` argument names no connected account (the message lists them). gsuite.auth_expired means the refresh token was rejected (for a Testing-mode OAuth app, Google expires it after 7 days). gsuite.permission_denied means the account cannot perform the minimal Gmail profile read.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Run connect_account to link an account, then retry the bounded connection check.
